ITEM 1 | Fresh green leafy greens (thin, deep-green, lobed leaves with thin stems, likely rocket-like), loosely piled on the left half of the plate, moist with slight sheen, covering roughly 25% of plate footprint, about 3-4 cm tall | 45
ITEM 2 | Pale cream-to-golden fillet of fish or similar flaky protein, moist, slightly glossy, with light browning on edges and flecks of green herb (thin fennel-like fronds) on top, cut into two or three irregular pieces about 8 x 5 cm total footprint, roughly 1.5-2 cm thick, sitting on the greens and grain | 130
ITEM 3 | Brown-red cooked grain or lentil-like mixture (small, dense, matte granules with slightly glossy coating), spread in a thin layer under the fish and greens, covering about 15% of plate, about 0.5-1 cm thick | 60
ITEM 4 | Cream-colored small beans or chickpea-like pieces, soft, slightly golden-tan, scattered among the fish and grain, about 0.8-1 cm each, roughly 8 pieces | 20
ITEM 5 | Translucent pale onion-like pieces, soft and slightly glossy with light golden edges, scattered near the fish and grain, small pieces about 1-2 cm | 15
ITEM 6 | Visible light sheen of oil or sauce glazing the fish and grain surfaces, thin film with no pooling on the white plate | 5
